title: Per-request compilation stays within its budget
statement: Over 50 consecutive requests for the largest stage document in the project, the 95th-percentile server-side compile-and-render time is at or below 300 ms on the reference host.
notes: ⚠️ THE 300 ms IS A TARGET, NOT A MEASUREMENT, and saying so is the point: DEC-0020 recorded this cost as explicitly unmeasured. If the first evaluation misses it by a wide margin the answer is not to relax the number — it is DEC-0020's own second alternative, plain markdown for stage documents. Recorded as a number rather than 'acceptable' so the criterion stays pass/fail.
